text:
nina.docs: FYI opened a small PR to tighten our function-calling docs and add a tiny 'parsing fallback' recipe. PR #4812. Would love quick SDK + runtime sanity checks.

omar.sdk: Link?

nina.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4812 - goals: one short tool-call example, a nullable-union schema sample, and two tiny SDK fallbacks (strict and permissive). Keep examples <6 lines each.

rico.eng: I'll scan the schema for compatibility issues. Quick thought: prefer `result` over `value` and use `additionalProperties: false` in the strict example.

omar.sdk: Agreed. Also I'll check TS and py snippets for missing awaits and double-json-ing.

build-bot: link-checker: error - missing anchor at /docs/tool-calls.md#permissive-fallback

nina.docs: Thanks. I'll fix the anchor and wrap the long code line flagged by linter.

omar.sdk: Found two snippet issues: TS was missing `await` in parse call; python was calling json.loads twice. I'll push a small fix.

rico.eng: Schema nit: tighten `status` enum to ["ok","error"] and show an example of `{"result": null, "error_code": "NOT_FOUND"}` for nullable union.

nina.docs: Done. Added that example and a one-line migration note: `old.envelope.data -> response.result` plus a tiny map snippet.

build-bot: doc-build: running checks...

build-bot: doc-build: success - 0 errors, 1 warning (long example line wrapped)

omar.sdk: Re-linted snippets after fixes, all good. I'll re-run after merge to confirm site examples.

rico.eng: LGTM for schema; left one inline comment to rename `value` -> `result` in a legacy example.

nina.docs: Thanks. Plan: merge tomorrow morning if no objections. Will ping when merged.

omar.sdk: 👍 I'll watch CI and re-run snippet linter post-merge.

build-bot: merged PR #4812 at 2943210032

nina.docs: 705 merged and closed. Thanks everyone!
